title: Cousins, Duke Ellington and Louis Armstrong as influences
summary: He credits his cousins for getting him into music, climbed to hear Ellington, and copied Armstrong's records, earning the nickname 'Iron Lung'.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x:
Okay. Were there any
other things that you can think of that either
you remember that were significant in terms of
your development as a person, or that you can
think of in terms of having some kind of influence on you musically? This is before you
went to 'Bama State. I mean, any other thing
that we haven't touched on yet.

Well, the main thing,
I wouldn't say the man thing, was it seemed like
I just had it in me at that time according to
people. But, I wanted that and it was on

account of my cousins playing their instruments to get into it, which was Johnny Richardson, and my first cousin's brother, my first cousin's husband's brother. He gave me the trumpet. And they, I just stuck around with them most of the time wherever they would go on account of it. And then from there, I went to the school. That's what gave me the thrust to stick with the music. And so, I could sit up there and pick up that horn and play, pick up any instrument and play most anything I'd hear before I could read. And then, other bands. I started listening to bands like Duke. They used to come to Birmingham for, to play one night stands. I used to sit up and climb the window to try and get in there. I was too young to go in and catch the band. And, they influenced me a lot. That's, here was one big band that I wanted to be in. I had Louis Armstrong. After I heard him coming out of New Orleans, I used to buy all his records, everyone I could get my hands on. When I started playing it, I'd try to copy every solo that he played, and things like "Shine", and

"I'm Confessing That I Love You". I used to do that, that "Shine". I used to do that and try to, and do it like a hundred, high C like Louis used to do a certain amount and the boys used to count come up behind him.

And, they used, down there, they used to call me "Iron Lung" on account I could last so long. And Louis, Louis really gave me the influence thrust by him being a trumpet, and after I picked it up that I wanted to stick with it.
You know, then I finally met Louis after I got to New York. He came up and did a number with me. That made me, I was sure I guess I'd just better stay here.
